comment: First sign-in of each user: script Setup-User.ps1 started by Active Setup.
The Active Setup registration is infrastructure: the generator adds it when at least one rule of the phase is on.
The script runtime provides Write-Log (a log per user).

rules.title: Pin the display language to the image language
rules.summary: Set-WinUILanguageOverride locks the display language to the installed one so that reordering input languages (English first) does not switch the interface.
rules.effect: The customer's requirement "do not change the display language" relies on this line.
rules.verify: Under the user account: Get-WinUILanguageOverride returns the image language (for example uk-UA); the display language has not changed after the first sign-in.
rules.rollback: Set-WinUILanguageOverride without a parameter removes the override.

script: if ($ui) { Set-WinUILanguageOverride -Language $ui; Write-Log "display language pinned to $ui" }

rules.title: User input language list from the profile (including "Russian (Ukraine)")
rules.summary: Replaces the user's input language list with the list from the "Languages and region" node (by default en-US, uk-UA, ru-UA), each language with the keyboard layouts the profile chose for it. Languages without a numeric code, such as "Russian (Ukraine)", cannot be set in XML, so they are applied here; if Windows has not assigned them a keyboard layout, a fallback list is applied in which they are replaced with the base language.
rules.effect: The user's language switcher shows the same order as the profile; the sign-in screen keeps the list from XML (with the base language instead of "Russian (Ukraine)").
rules.versions: ru-UA as an input language is supported by Windows 10 1803+ and 11; on build 26200 it gets the temporary code 2000:00000419. Windows may shorten tags (uk-UA is displayed as uk).

script: Write-Log ('no keyboard layout after apply for: ' + ($missing -join ', ') + '; applying the fallback list')
Write-Log 'the opt-out of the Accept-Language list from the default profile is kept'
} catch { Write-Log "the opt-out of the Accept-Language list was not kept: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
